page.overview:
Who is Aigaios?

Aigaios belongs to Greek mythology. Little is known about the Potamoi Aigaios.

What is known is that he was a river-god of Skherie, the mythical home of the Phaiakes. The Phaiakian island was sometimes identified as Black Korkyra.

In Greek mythology, Aigaios sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
